class Shipment < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :order
  enum :status, { pending: 0, in_transit: 1, delivered: 2 }

  def delivered_late?
    delivered? && delivered_at > promised_at
  end
end

class TopSellersQuery
  def call(since: 30.days.ago, limit: 10)
    Product.joins(:order_items)
           .where(order_items: { created_at: since.. })
           .group("products.id")
           .order(Arel.sql("SUM(order_items.quantity) DESC"))
           .limit(limit)
           .select("products.*, SUM(order_items.quantity) AS units_sold")
  end
end

namespace :backfill do
  task normalize_phone_numbers: :environment do
    Customer.where(phone_e164: nil).in_batches(of: 1000) do |batch|
      batch.update_all("phone_e164 = regexp_replace(phone, '[^0-9+]', '', 'g')")
    end
  end
end

module Tax
  class RateTable
    RATES = { "DE" => 0.19, "FR" => 0.20, "NL" => 0.21 }.freeze

    def self.labels
      RATES.map { |country, rate| "#{country}: #{(rate * 100).round}%" }
    end
  end
end
